calibration: one excluded baseline and candidate pilot per case; common calls are maximum of their 150-ms CPU target estimates
window_order: alternating single/double pairs; double executes twice the same outer call count
scope: optimized public InferenceSession run or prepare+run, including output destruction; one Rayon/decode thread; synthetic exact Q8 arithmetic; no model or GPU extrapolation
cold_scope: model/input creation, session construction and first fully validated run; excludes process startup, Rayon/provider/Host-pool construction; diagnostic only
validation_scope: additional untimed complete-output request after each timed window; timed outputs are black-boxed and dropped inside the window
host_observation: shared stable Darwin flock for complete cohort; uncached Mach host_processor_info over each whole process minus complete child CPU; no affinity and no window-level foreign CPU bound
failure_policy: one frozen cohort, retain all failures, no repeats selected by measured outcomes; every process/control gate must pass for a cell to publish ratios; overlapping process ranges do not resolve a difference
memory_scope: 64 MiB governed workspace/derived limit, not a process memory cap; warm issuer callback deltas zero; actual CPU pool retained identity checked; teardown/trim settle to zero
digest_algorithm: 64-bit FNV-style u32-word fold, one xor/multiply per output bit word
